# Finnova Ltd — Digital Inclusion for Every Australian

> Finnova Ltd is an Australian registered charity (ACNC), Public Benevolent Institution (PBI), and ISO 27001:2022 certified organisation dedicated to advancing digital inclusion, cybersecurity literacy, myGov guidance, and Census 2026 support across Australia.

## Overview & Core Mission
Finnova Ltd bridges the digital divide for elderly, vulnerable, CALD (Culturally and Linguistically Diverse), and migrant Australians through free, multilingual, and consent-led community programs.

## Key Services & Programs
- [National Inclusion Programs](https://finnova.org.au/#services): Free 1-on-1 and group digital literacy workshops in 12+ languages.
- [Assisted myGov Sessions](https://finnova.org.au/#services): Patient, in-person assistance for navigating Centrelink, Medicare, ATO, and digital identity services with strict privacy controls.
- [Cyber Safety & Scam Protection](https://finnova.org.au/#cyber): Free advice and community workshops on identifying scams, phishing, safe passwords, and protecting personal identity online.
- [Census 2026 Support](https://finnova.org.au/#census-explorer): Community assistance to ensure every household can complete the compulsory Australian Census safely and accurately.
- [Refurbished Hardware & Tech Access](https://finnova.org.au/#services): Providing low-cost and free refurbished laptops, tablets, and mobile devices to low-income families and seniors.
